worked_solution:
Recall that for any random variable $X$ and constant $a,$ we have

$$
\text{Var}[aX]={a}^{2}\cdot \text{Var}[X].
$$

In our case, $a=\frac{10}{3}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[\frac{10}{3}X] & ={(\frac{10}{3})}^{2}\cdot \text{Var}[X] \\  & =\frac{100}{9}\cdot 3.6 \\  & =40.\end{aligned}
$$
